_comment: Boat upgrade tracks. Tier 0 is the starting state. cost: coins + materials. requires: story step id or discovered biome. Kept gentle: no grind.

tiers.name: Old Oars
tiers.desc: Your grandmother's oars. They know the way.

tiers.name: Sculling Oars
tiers.desc: Longer, lighter blades. A little faster and easier to turn.

tiers.name: Little Sail
tiers.desc: A patched canvas sail. The wind helps you along.

tiers.name: Clockwork Paddle
tiers.desc: A wind-up paddle wheel from a canyon tinkerer. Steady cruising without rowing.

tiers.name: Wicker Basket
tiers.desc: Room for the essentials.

tiers.name: Stout Crate
tiers.desc: A proper crate lashed under the stern seat.

tiers.name: Twin Crates
tiers.desc: Two crates, neatly stacked.

tiers.name: Traveller's Hold
tiers.desc: Three crates and clever netting. Carry anything.

tiers.name: Oil Lantern
tiers.desc: A small warm light for dark evenings.

tiers.name: Brass Lantern
tiers.desc: Brighter and further-reaching.

tiers.name: Lamplighter's Lantern
tiers.desc: Cool starlight. Reveals the old glowmarks and parts the hidden veil.

tiers.name: Worn Planks
tiers.desc: Sound enough, if a little creaky.

tiers.name: Reinforced Hull
tiers.desc: Steadier in rapids and storms; bumps hardly slow you.

tiers.name: Riverwright Hull
tiers.desc: Master-built. Glides through rough water.

tiers.name: Willow Rod
tiers.desc: Simple and dependable.

tiers.name: Split-Cane Rod
tiers.desc: Fish bite sooner.

tiers.name: Lacquered Rod
tiers.desc: Rare fish are more tempted, and the line is gentler to hold.

tiers.name: Star Rod
tiers.desc: Legends seem to notice it.

tiers.name: Pocket Compass
tiers.desc: North is where it always was.

tiers.name: River Chart
tiers.desc: Your map hints at landmarks you haven't found yet.

tiers.name: Star Compass
tiers.desc: A needle that points to the nearest undiscovered wonder.

tiers.name: Flat Cushion
tiers.desc: Better than a bare plank.

tiers.name: Canvas Awning
tiers.desc: Keeps the rain off your head.

tiers.name: Awning & Kettle
tiers.desc: Brew tea on board and rest until the next time of day.

tiers.name: Keen Eyes
tiers.desc: You notice more than most.

tiers.name: Spyglass
tiers.desc: Zoom in (hold right mouse / LT in exploration camera) and identify distant landmarks.

tiers.name: Field Camera
tiers.desc: Unlocks photo filters and a wider focus range.

tiers.name: Bare Bow
tiers.desc: Nothing but a stem post.

tiers.name: Carved Heron
tiers.desc: A proud little heron watches the way ahead.
